items.name: tauri-adapter
items.title: Tauri Update Adapter
items.description: UpdateAdapter implementation for Tauri: plugin-updater check (minisign-verified) + standalone download/install, client_id via X-Client-Id header.

items.name: update-texts
items.title: Update UI Texts
items.description: Framework-agnostic copy presets (en / zh-CN) for the update UI; override individual strings via props.

items.name: use-update
items.title: useUpdate
items.description: React hook reading the update engine from context, plus createSwarmHiveEngine() that assembles adapter + current version + client_id.

items.name: release-notes-view
items.title: Release Notes View
items.description: Release notes renderer slot: plain text by default, pluggable Markdown renderer via the renderer prop.

items.name: download-panel
items.title: Download Panel
items.description: Public website/download-page component: fetches SwarmHive download catalog, detects platform, and renders installable artifacts.

items.name: update-provider
items.title: Update Provider
items.description: Async-assembles the update engine and provides it via context; optional check-on-mount and recheck-on-focus.

items.name: prompt-update-dialog
items.title: Prompt Update Dialog
items.description: Optional update dialog with later / update-now actions, release notes, and inline download progress.

items.name: force-update-dialog
items.title: Force Update Dialog
items.description: Non-dismissable update dialog shown when the server marks the release as a forced upgrade.

items.name: update-progress-dialog
items.title: Update Progress Dialog
items.description: Standalone download-progress dialog, auto-shown while downloading / installing.

items.name: update-settings-section
items.title: Update Settings Section
items.description: Settings-page section: check / download buttons, status text, progress banner, and error retry.
